title: Dynamic client registration (RFC 7591): every JMAP client that might show up cannot be pre-registered
description: A personal provider cannot hold a list of approved JMAP clients, so RFC 7591 dynamic client registration is how an unknown client becomes one the AS will talk to. Needs its own limits: what a registration may claim, how many a provider keeps, and what an operator can turn off. Also the question of what the consent screen says when the client registered itself minutes ago.
